description: This file defines a PHP class 'CurrentAndChangeEntitlement' within the 'OrangeHRM\Leave\Dto' namespace. The class models data related to employee leave entitlements, specifically current entitlements and changes, using associative arrays. It includes constructor, getter, and setter methods for its properties.

classes.name: CurrentAndChangeEntitlement
classes.description: A data transfer object (DTO) representing current and changed leave entitlements, with properties for current entitlements ('current') and entitlement adjustments ('change'), including methods to get and set these properties.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Initializes the object with optional arrays for current entitlements and changes.
